summary: Fluxer is a self-hosted instant messaging and VoIP platform designed for private groups, friends, and online communities. It serves as an open-source alternative to proprietary chat services like Discord, allowing you to host your own communication infrastructure. The software is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence and manages communication channels through a containerised architecture.
goodFor: It is well-suited for groups that want to migrate away from third-party chat platforms and retain full ownership of their communication data.
watchOut: Adopting an alternative to heavily established chat platforms often requires convincing your community to migrate and manage separate client connections.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
